title: Handoff (exeris-docs)
description:
The bundle's shape, narrowed to this repository's roles. The shape is not restated here: if a field's meaning is in question, the base is the answer. agents-md-schema.md rule 13.

The `unevaluatedProperties: false` in this file are this file's own: the bundle's bases declare none, because a base that closes itself refuses the very property a composing schema adds (exeris-agents 2.0.0). A closer stops at the object it sits in, so an array's items need one of their own — a root closer alone refuses a foreign property at the root and admits one inside an item. `agents_file_check.py` names every object left open.
